title: Rathbaun House, Bride Street, Loughrea, Co. Galway
seoTitle: Rathbaun House, Bride Street, Loughrea, Co. Galway
description:
This property is located in the centre of Loughrea town and is a mixed use development.
This property comprises of nine residential units and three commercial units.
Located in the centre of Loughrea town, the property is finished to a high standard and benefits from private communal parking.
The property is in close proximity to schools, shops, pubs, cafes and other local amenities. 
Travel by bus on Citylink on their  Galway to Loughrea bus service. Loughrea is a satellite town of Galway City, so has regular bus services every day. Alternatively travel by car from Galway taking the M6 and N65 road west from Galway City.
